verdict.rationale: Asaas documents API-key access and lists payment links among its API features, so an agent could plausibly create a payment link programmatically. Nothing in the evidence shows product or price catalog objects, so most of the provisioning chain is unproven. The MCP server is documented only for querying documentation, not for performing API actions. Missing for 10: documented product/catalog creation endpoint, price object creation, payment-link creation endpoint details, evidence of an end-to-end agent session flow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: Features such as subscriptions, payment links, split, receivables anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, and Webhooks are also available.
The Asaas API uses an API key to identify the account responsible for the request.
